contexts.text: Man is led by the Lord through Heaven...
The human race... is not ruled through. Heaven, but from it...
It is said through others, because neither have these received anything from themselves.
God the Father does not operate... through the Son...
So these leaders do not speak through their followers...
The heart does not breathe through the lungs.
If evil acted through man, he could not be reformed; nor could he if good acted through him...
So man's internal does not act through his external...
The Lord does not act through man... (just as) the soul does not act through the body... And it is the same with the Divine and the Human in the Lord...
The Second advent effected by means of a man. (Explained.)
That which is written through me.
3. The books... written by the Lord through me.
